evals.prompt: Implement the accepted application scope; no UAT campaign was requested and no live environment exists.
evals.expected_output: Run mandatory development checks, retain not_requested UAT, and allow otherwise eligible delivery without runtime identities or synthetic PASS.
assertions: Run mandatory development checks, retain not_requested UAT, and allow otherwise eligible delivery without runtime identities or synthetic PASS.

evals.prompt: UAT was requested after implementation, but a required external service is unavailable when the scope is complete.
evals.expected_output: Record pending UAT and missing prerequisites with the exact candidate handoff; do not retry optional setup indefinitely or block eligible PR/merge. Preserve any actual failed assertions.
assertions: Record pending UAT and missing prerequisites with the exact candidate handoff; do not retry optional setup indefinitely or block eligible PR/merge. Preserve any actual failed assertions.

evals.prompt: In an already verified Agentic SDLC run, use $sdlc-start for its normal phase on an unchanged FEAT-only basis with no source manifest. Reuse unchanged instructions already loaded in this session. Explain the required reads and next action without executing effects.
evals.expected_output: Load the shared invariants and phase inputs. Load deep execution or delivery detail only when the phase operation triggers it; preserve native ownership, exact basis checks and phase-specific gates.
assertions: The answer preserves the verified coordinator and exact current evidence requirements.
Execution owners still require the execution contract; protected publication still requires document delivery.
Unchanged instruction reuse never becomes a cache of authority, Git identity or passing mutable evidence.

evals.prompt: Use $sdlc-start in a verified resumed SLICE workflow after a source manifest and checkpoint changed. Optional UAT still lacks the same external prerequisite. Explain the safe continuation and required reads without executing effects.
evals.expected_output: Reload changed/compacted instructions and current checkpoint. Load document delivery for SLICE/source coverage and execution details for lifecycle effects; preserve pending optional UAT without repeated setup or repair-budget charges.
assertions: The answer retains source coverage, serial barriers, immutable history and full relevant detail.
Changed identity invalidates reuse and requires owner revalidation.
Pending optional UAT is not a synthetic PASS and does not trigger unchanged setup/research loops.
